$comment: Editorial batch 2026q (CONT-26): trivia pairs for iconic TV series with constant search demand and zero catalogue coverage — Breaking Bad, Money Heist / La Casa de Papel, The Sopranos, Peaky Blinders and The Big Bang Theory. Every answer is a stable, checkable fact from finished runs. Emitted by scripts/seed/emit-editorial-seed.mjs.

quizzes.title: Breaking Bad Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: Five seasons in Albuquerque turned a chemistry teacher into Heisenberg. From the RV in the desert to Los Pollos Hermanos — how much do you remember?

questions.question: What is Walter White's job when the series begins?
questions.explanation: Walt teaches chemistry at an Albuquerque high school and works a second job at a car wash.

questions.question: What alias does Walter White adopt in the drug world?
questions.explanation: He takes the name from physicist Werner Heisenberg; Cap'n Cook is Jesse's early street name.

questions.question: In which city does Breaking Bad take place?
questions.explanation: The whole story plays out in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

questions.question: Who plays Walter White?
questions.explanation: Bryan Cranston won four Emmys for the role; Aaron Paul plays Jesse Pinkman.

questions.question: What fast-food chain fronts Gus Fring's operation?
questions.explanation: Los Pollos Hermanos is Gus's cover — its farm and restaurant hide his distribution network.

questions.question: What color is Walt and Jesse's signature product?
questions.explanation: The purity gives it a blue tint that makes it famous as 'blue sky'.

questions.question: What does Hank Schrader, Walt's brother-in-law, do for a living?
questions.explanation: Hank is a DEA agent hunting Heisenberg without knowing he is his own brother-in-law.

questions.question: What vehicle do Walt and Jesse use as a mobile lab in the first seasons?
questions.explanation: A beat-up recreational vehicle nicknamed 'the Krystal Ship' — until it is destroyed.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Breaking Bad
quizzes.description: De profesor de química a capo: cinco temporadas en Albuquerque que cambiaron la televisión. ¿Cuánto recuerdas de Heisenberg y su imperio?

questions.question: ¿Cuál es la profesión de Walter White al inicio de la serie?
questions.explanation: Walt enseña química en una escuela secundaria de Albuquerque y tiene un segundo empleo en un lavado de autos.

questions.question: ¿Qué alias usa Walter en el mundo del narcotráfico?
questions.explanation: Toma el nombre del físico Werner Heisenberg; El Camino es el título de la película epílogo.

questions.question: ¿En qué ciudad ocurre la historia?
questions.explanation: Toda la serie se desarrolla en Albuquerque, Nuevo México.

questions.question: ¿Quién interpreta a Walter White?
questions.explanation: Bryan Cranston ganó cuatro premios Emmy por el papel; Aaron Paul interpreta a Jesse Pinkman.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llama la cadena de comida rápida que usa Gus Fring como fachada?
questions.explanation: Los Pollos Hermanos es la tapadera de Gus y el centro de su red de distribución.

questions.question: ¿De qué color es el producto característico de Walt y Jesse?
questions.explanation: Su pureza le da un tinte azul que lo hace famoso como 'blue sky'.

questions.question: ¿Qué hace Hank Schrader, el cuñado de Walt?
questions.explanation: Hank es agente de la DEA y persigue a Heisenberg sin saber que es su propio cuñado.

questions.question: ¿En qué vehículo cocinan Walt y Jesse al principio?
questions.explanation: Una casa rodante vieja apodada 'la Krystal Ship', que termina destruida.

quizzes.title: Money Heist Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: La Casa de Papel turned a Spanish heist into a global phenomenon. The Professor, red jumpsuits and Dalí masks — test your memory of the gang.

questions.question: What is the original Spanish title of Money Heist?
questions.explanation: It premiered in Spain as La Casa de Papel in 2017 before Netflix made it a worldwide hit.

questions.question: The robbers hide their identities behind aliases named after…
questions.explanation: Tokyo, Berlin, Denver, Moscow, Rio, Nairobi, Helsinki, Oslo — city names, so nobody knows each other.

questions.question: Which member of the gang narrates the series?
questions.explanation: Tokyo, played by Úrsula Corberó, is the voice telling the story.

questions.question: What is the target of the gang's first heist?
questions.explanation: The first job seizes the Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre to print their own money; the Bank of Spain is the second heist.

questions.question: Whose face appears on the gang's masks?
questions.explanation: Dalí masks plus red jumpsuits became the show's signature image.

questions.question: Which song becomes the gang's anthem?
questions.explanation: The Italian protest song Bella Ciao is sung by the Professor and Berlin.

questions.question: Who plays the Professor?
questions.explanation: Álvaro Morte plays Sergio Marquina, the Professor; Pedro Alonso is Berlin.

questions.question: Which police inspector ends up joining the gang under a city alias?
questions.explanation: Inspector Raquel Murillo leaves the force and joins as 'Lisbon'; Alicia Sierra is a later antagonist inspector.

quizzes.title: Trivia de La Casa de Papel
quizzes.description: El Profesor, los monos rojos y las máscaras de Dalí: el atraco español que conquistó el mundo. ¿Cuánto recuerdas de la serie?

questions.question: ¿Cómo se tituló la serie en inglés?
questions.explanation: Netflix la estrenó internacionalmente como Money Heist.

questions.question: Los miembros de la banda usan alias tomados de…
questions.explanation: Tokio, Berlín, Denver, Moscú, Río, Nairobi, Helsinki, Oslo: nombres de ciudades para que nadie se conozca.

questions.question: ¿Quién narra la serie?
questions.explanation: Tokio, interpretada por Úrsula Corberó, es la voz que cuenta la historia.

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el objetivo del primer atraco de la banda?

options.text: La Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre

questions.explanation: En el primer golpe ocupan la Fábrica de Moneda y Timbre para imprimir su propio dinero; el Banco de España es el segundo.

questions.question: ¿De quién es la cara de las máscaras de la banda?
questions.explanation: La máscara de Dalí y el mono rojo se volvieron la imagen emblemática de la serie.

questions.question: ¿Qué canción se convierte en el himno de la banda?
questions.explanation: Bella Ciao, el canto de protesta italiano, la cantan el Profesor y Berlín.

questions.question: ¿Quién interpreta al Profesor?
questions.explanation: Álvaro Morte es Sergio Marquina, el Profesor; Pedro Alonso interpreta a Berlín.

questions.question: ¿Qué parentesco une a Berlín con el Profesor?
questions.explanation: Andrés de Fonollosa, 'Berlín', es el hermano mayor del Profesor.

quizzes.title: The Sopranos Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: A New Jersey mob boss in therapy: six seasons that changed television forever. How well do you know Tony Soprano and his two families?

questions.question: Who plays Tony Soprano?
questions.explanation: James Gandolfini won three Emmys as Tony; Edie Falco plays his wife Carmela.

questions.question: In which U.S. state is the series set?
questions.explanation: The DiMeo family operates out of North Jersey — the opening credits drive through it.

questions.question: What is the name of Tony's psychiatrist?
questions.explanation: Dr. Jennifer Melfi treats Tony's panic attacks; Kupferberg is her own therapist.

questions.question: Which network aired The Sopranos?
questions.explanation: HBO premiered it in 1999 — the show that defined prestige television.

questions.question: What is the name of the strip club the crew uses as headquarters?
questions.explanation: Bada Bing! is the front; Vesuvio is Artie Bucco's restaurant and Satriale's is the pork store.

questions.question: What animals settle in Tony's swimming pool in the first season?
questions.explanation: The ducks — and their departure — trigger Tony's first panic attack.

questions.question: Who is Christopher Moltisanti to Tony?
questions.explanation: Christopher is the nephew Tony is grooming as his successor — played by Michael Imperioli.

questions.question: How does the series finale famously end?

options.text: A cut to black in a diner
A funeral for the whole family

questions.explanation: The 2007 finale cuts to black mid-scene at Holsten's diner — still debated today.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Los Soprano
quizzes.description: Un capo de Nueva Jersey que va al psiquiatra: seis temporadas que cambiaron la televisión. ¿Qué tan bien conoces a Tony Soprano?

questions.question: ¿Quién interpreta a Tony Soprano?
questions.explanation: James Gandolfini ganó tres premios Emmy por el papel.

questions.question: ¿En qué estado de Estados Unidos ocurre la serie?
questions.explanation: La familia DiMeo opera en el norte de Nueva Jersey; los créditos iniciales recorren ese paisaje.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llama la psiquiatra de Tony?
questions.explanation: La doctora Jennifer Melfi trata los ataques de pánico de Tony.

questions.question: ¿Qué canal estrenó Los Soprano?
questions.explanation: HBO la estrenó en 1999; la serie marcó la era de la televisión de prestigio.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llama el club que la banda usa como cuartel?
questions.explanation: Bada Bing! es la fachada; Vesuvio es el restaurante de Artie Bucco y Satriale's la carnicería.

questions.question: ¿Qué animales se instalan en la piscina de Tony en la primera temporada?
questions.explanation: Los patos — y su partida — detonan el primer ataque de pánico de Tony.

questions.question: ¿Qué parentesco une a Christopher Moltisanti con Tony?
questions.explanation: Christopher es el sobrino al que Tony prepara como sucesor; lo interpreta Michael Imperioli.

questions.question: ¿Cómo termina el último episodio de la serie?

options.text: Un corte a negro en un restaurante

questions.explanation: El final de 2007 corta a negro en medio de una escena en el restaurante Holsten's; todavía se debate su significado.

quizzes.title: Peaky Blinders Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: Birmingham, 1919: the Shelby family climbs from backstreet bookies to empire. By order of the Peaky Blinders — prove you know the gang.

questions.question: Which family is at the center of the series?
questions.explanation: The Shelby family runs the Peaky Blinders; Changretta, Sabini and Lee are rival clans.

questions.question: In which English city does the story begin?
questions.explanation: The gang rules the working-class streets of Small Heath, Birmingham, right after World War I.

questions.question: Who plays Tommy Shelby?
questions.explanation: Cillian Murphy is Thomas Shelby; Paul Anderson plays his brother Arthur.

questions.question: According to legend, what do the Peaky Blinders keep sewn into their caps?
questions.explanation: The gang's name comes from razor blades hidden in the peaks of their flat caps.

questions.question: What is the gang's famous catchphrase?
questions.explanation: 'By order of the Peaky Blinders' is the line fans quote everywhere.

questions.question: Which actor plays the unpredictable Alfie Solomons?
questions.explanation: Tom Hardy plays the Camden Town gang leader; Adrien Brody is Luca Changretta and Sam Neill is Inspector Campbell.

questions.question: What is the Shelby family's first business?
questions.explanation: Shelby Company Limited starts with backstreet betting shops before expanding into bigger ventures.

questions.question: Who is Polly Gray to the Shelby brothers?
questions.explanation: Aunt Polly, played by Helen McCrory, is the matriarch and the company's treasurer.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Peaky Blinders
quizzes.description: Birmingham, 1919: la familia Shelby pasa de las apuestas callejeras a un imperio. Por orden de los Peaky Blinders, demuestra cuánto sabes.

questions.question: ¿Qué familia protagoniza la serie?
questions.explanation: Los Shelby lideran a los Peaky Blinders; Changretta, Sabini y Lee son clanes rivales.

questions.question: ¿En qué ciudad inglesa comienza la historia?
questions.explanation: La banda controla las calles obreras de Small Heath, en Birmingham, justo después de la Primera Guerra Mundial.

questions.question: ¿Quién interpreta a Tommy Shelby?
questions.explanation: Cillian Murphy es Thomas Shelby; Paul Anderson interpreta a su hermano Arthur.

questions.question: Según la leyenda, ¿qué llevan los Peaky Blinders cosido en las viseras de sus gorras?
questions.explanation: El nombre de la banda viene de las cuchillas escondidas en la visera de sus gorras.

questions.question: ¿Cuál es la frase emblemática de la banda?
questions.explanation: 'Por orden de los Peaky Blinders': la frase que los seguidores repiten en todas partes.

questions.question: ¿Qué actor interpreta al impredecible Alfie Solomons?
questions.explanation: Tom Hardy es el líder de Camden Town; Adrien Brody interpreta a Luca Changretta.

questions.question: ¿Con qué negocio empieza la familia Shelby?
questions.explanation: Shelby Company Limited arranca con casas de apuestas clandestinas antes de expandirse a negocios legales e ilegales.

questions.question: ¿Qué es Polly Gray para los hermanos Shelby?
questions.explanation: La tía Polly, interpretada por Helen McCrory, es la matriarca y la tesorera de la empresa.

quizzes.title: The Big Bang Theory Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: Twelve seasons of physics, comic books and 'Bazinga!'. From apartment 4A to the Nobel stage — how much do you remember about Sheldon and the gang?

questions.question: What does Sheldon shout after one of his pranks or zingers?
questions.explanation: 'Bazinga!' is Sheldon's signature 'I fooled you' exclamation.

questions.question: Where do Sheldon, Leonard, Raj and Howard work?
questions.explanation: All four are researchers at Caltech in Pasadena, California.

questions.question: What is Penny's job when the series begins?
questions.explanation: Penny waits tables at The Cheesecake Factory while chasing an acting career.

questions.question: Which of the guys goes to the International Space Station?
questions.explanation: Engineer Howard Wolowitz flies to the ISS — and never lets anyone forget he is an astronaut.

questions.question: Who plays Sheldon Cooper?
questions.explanation: Jim Parsons won four Emmys as Sheldon; Johnny Galecki plays Leonard.

questions.question: What song does Penny sing to Sheldon when he is sick?
questions.explanation: 'Soft kitty, warm kitty' — the lullaby his mother sang to him as a child.

questions.question: According to the show, why is the building's elevator broken?

options.text: Leonard destroyed it with a rocket fuel experiment
Penny's furniture got stuck in it

questions.explanation: A season 3 flashback shows Leonard's rocket fuel experiment exploding inside the elevator.

questions.question: How many seasons did the show run?
questions.explanation: Twelve seasons and 279 episodes, from 2007 to 2019.

quizzes.title: Trivia de The Big Bang Theory
quizzes.description: Doce temporadas de física, cómics y '¡Bazinga!'. Del departamento 4A al escenario del Nobel: ¿cuánto recuerdas de Sheldon y su grupo?

questions.question: ¿Qué grita Sheldon después de una de sus bromas?
questions.explanation: '¡Bazinga!' es la marca registrada de Sheldon cuando alguien cae en sus bromas.

questions.question: ¿Dónde trabajan Sheldon, Leonard, Raj y Howard?
questions.explanation: Los cuatro son investigadores de Caltech, en Pasadena, California.

questions.question: ¿De qué trabaja Penny al inicio de la serie?
questions.explanation: Penny atiende mesas en The Cheesecake Factory mientras persigue su carrera de actriz.

questions.question: ¿Quién del grupo viaja a la Estación Espacial Internacional?
questions.explanation: El ingeniero Howard Wolowitz viaja a la EEI y no deja de recordar que es astronauta.

questions.question: ¿Quién interpreta a Sheldon Cooper?
questions.explanation: Jim Parsons ganó cuatro premios Emmy por el papel; Johnny Galecki es Leonard.

questions.question: ¿Qué canción le canta Penny a Sheldon cuando está enfermo?
questions.explanation: 'Soft kitty, warm kitty': la canción de cuna que su mamá le cantaba de niño.

questions.question: Según la serie, ¿por qué está descompuesto el ascensor del edificio?

options.text: Leonard lo destruyó con un experimento de combustible de cohetes
Un mueble de Penny lo atascó

questions.explanation: Un flashback de la tercera temporada muestra el experimento de Leonard explotando dentro del ascensor.

questions.question: ¿Cuántas temporadas tuvo la serie?
questions.explanation: Doce temporadas y 279 episodios, de 2007 a 2019.
